messages:
Sylvia: Quick heads-up — ran an intake quant sweep for argo14b (FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8) across us-central1 (A100), eu-west1 (H100), apac-east1 (L4). Uploading raw logs to s3: s3://redwood-quant/argo14b/2251234567.csv
Tanay: Nice. What's the delta on quality for INT8? :eyes:
Mike: TL;DR: INT8 avg latency (512 tokens): A100 42ms (≈1.9x speedup vs FP16), H100 37ms (≈2.1x), L4 55ms (≈1.5x). Throughput p50/p95 (qps): A100 120/85, H100 150/110, L4 60/45.
Jess: Quality quick summary: eval set (llm-eval-2k) accuracy baseline FP16 76.2%, INT8 75.1% (-1.1% abs), FP8 75.7% (-0.5% abs). Perplexity shift FP16->INT8 +0.8.
Sylvia: Kernel notes: A100 used custom int8-kernel-v3 (continuous-batch). H100 used fp8 path with qprofile-7 and an int8 fallback on dense matmul. L4 still hits fallback paths a lot -> higher p95 variance.
Tanay: Any memory wins? how many model instances per GPU for stable p50?
Mike: Capacity rough numbers (512-token typical): A100 80GB — argo14b int8 ~2.8 models/GPU (target ~100 qps per model), FP16 ~1.4 models/GPU. H100 80GB ~3.2 int8 models/GPU, FP8 lets us push concurrency higher. L4 48GB ~1.4 int8 models/GPU, FP16 ~0.7.
Jess: Paste of the snippet I used to generate charts:
```
region,gpu,precision,p50_lat_ms,p95_lat_ms,qps_p50
us-central1,A100,FP16,80,140,60
us-central1,A100,INT8,42,90,120
eu-west1,H100,FP16,70,120,80
eu-west1,H100,FP8,33,75,150
apac-east1,L4,FP16,110,200,35
apac-east1,L4,INT8,55,95,60
```
Rachel: Observed quality regressions are concentrated on long-context QA prompts — hallucination spikes for some examples with INT8. Need prompt-level diffs and token-level logp comparisons.
bench-bot: Auto-chart generated: https://dash.redwood/quant/plots/2251234567 (latency/throughput/quality overlays, regional breakdowns).
Sylvia: Proposed rollout: canary INT8 on A100 only (us-central1), monitor eval_qa_long and rlhf_sanity for 24h. If stable, enable H100 with FP8 paths enabled and watch kernel-fallback rates.
Tanay: Agreed. Add auto-fallback policy: if QA acc drift > 0.7% abs over baseline, route that customer traffic to FP16.
Jess: I'll prepare an A/B prompt set focused on long-context QA + instruction-following. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Mike: One more operational note: H100 fp8->int8 kernel switch cost ~3ms extra on first token due to kernel selection/compilation path; negligible for >128 tokens but matters for short requests. Add to canary checklist.
Sylvia: Logging/observability items: capture per-route kernel-fallback rate, per-prompt perplexity delta, and token-level runtimes. I'll add these to the experiment issue in Linear: https://linear.app/rwi/issue/ARGO-142
Sylvia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
